integrity: Full analytical proof supplied; finite checker exercises small instances and analytic patterns and is not treated as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Characterizes unconditional witnessing across all valuations, not individual valuations, completeness or modal definability. Existing finite-branching facts credited; possible subsumption of the diamond criterion by general possibility-measure literature remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Universal modal witnessing on fuzzy Gödel frames: two sharp row criteria
